useWhen: Identify and analyze real organizations' monopoly, oligopoly and market concentration by region and relevant market; publish attributed primary evidence and coverage gaps.
avoidWhen: Legal verdicts from share thresholds, source-free allegations, fictitious entities, punitive blocklists or automatic activation.

inputs.region: ISO country/territory, EEA, WORLD or explicitly defined subnational scope
inputs.sources: primary public evidence with precise locators

outputs.findings: versioned JSON with legal status, metrics and uncertainty
outputs.coverage: unresearched geography/industry cells and overdue reviews

authority.binding: Owning repository profile and host-bound web/model policy; repository publication by caller authorization. Legacy Datom broadcast remains member-signed and separately gated.

validation.runtime: Python evidence/report pipeline: 10 behavioral tests; host-installed agent not qualified

compatibilityNote: Actual profile and executable remain in the owning repository. A registry template neither installs the bot nor binds provider/model or enables a cron.
